items.title: CrowdStrike announces 'kill switch' for AI agents that go rogue
items.summary: CrowdStrike has agreed to buy two AI security startups for a combined purchase price of $495 million, according to the Wall Street Journal.

items.title: CrowdStrike Launches AI Agent 'Kill Switch,' Plans to Acquire Fiddler AI
items.summary: CrowdStrike's new kill switch lets security teams cut off unauthorized AI agents through a gateway, while its planned Fiddler acquisition aims to make autonomous software easier to monitor and audit.

items.title: CrowdStrike Makes $495 Million Bet on AI Security
items.summary: The deals give CrowdStrike new tools to test and monitor autonomous AI agents.

items.title: CrowdStrike to Pay $495 Million for Two AI Startups
items.summary: The deals landed alongside a new AI Kill Switch aimed at unauthorized agent activity

items.title: CrowdStrike to shell out nearly $500M for 2 AI security startups as the market for securing agents takes off
items.summary: CrowdStrike said it will buy Fiddler AI, which makes AI agent observability software, and Dreadnode, which helps companies automate AI security testing.

items.title: Cerebras Systems Craters Again, Down Nearly 50% Year-to-Date: 240% Gains to Come According to This Wall Street Analyst
items.summary: A short report, an insider selling flood, and whispers that its biggest customer jumped ship sent Cerebras crashing below $100. One Wall Street analyst just slapped a Buy on the rubble and sees a path to triple-digit gains.

items.title: CrowdStrike Integrates Falcon Guardian Security Into Anthropic’s Claude Cowork to Protect AI Agents
items.summary: CrowdStrike (NASDAQ:CRWD) has announced a new integration between its Falcon Guardian AI Detection and Response (AIDR) technology and Anthropic’s Claude Cowork platform, extending enterprise cybersecurity protection to artificial intelligence agents.
